--- title: "Communities" format: html --- # Asian Open Source Communities Browse through our comprehensive list of open source communities across Asia. Use the filters below to find communities by region or category. ## Community Directory ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} datatable( communities, filter = 'top', options = list( pageLength = 10, autoWidth = TRUE ) ) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ## How to Add Your Community If your community is not listed, you can add it by: 1. Creating a GitHub Issue using our template 2. Submitting a Pull Request with your community details See our [Contribution Guidelines](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for more information.
